FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At The Daily Brew, we specialize in providing a warm and inviting atmosphere for coffee and tea enthusiasts. Our operations focus on serving a variety of high-quality brewed beverages, alongside a selection of light snacks and pastries. We prioritize customer experience by training our staff in food safety and excellent customer service, ensuring a welcoming environment that encourages repeat visits.

Our shop comfortably accommodates up to 150 patrons, making it easy for customers to enjoy their drinks either in-house or through a takeout service. Our space is designed to maintain cleanliness and safety, with regular sanitation schedules in place.

We pride ourselves on continuous operation throughout the year, ensuring we remain available for our community while adhering to all local health and safety regulations. We maintain strong fire safety protocols and consistently work with reputable local suppliers to ensure product quality. Our menu evolves seasonally to keep offerings fresh, but never includes high-risk cooking methods, aligning with our commitment to maintaining a safe and compliant establishment.
